lead: Nita Ambani is best known as an Indian philanthropist, born on 1 November 1963 in Mumbai.
As of 2026, she is 62 years old, and her birth date places her under the Scorpio sign.
She has held the office of chairperson and member of the International Olympic Committee.

sections.heading: Nita Ambani — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Nita Ambani was born on 1 November 1963 in Mumbai, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name her father, Ravindrabhai Dalal and her mother, Purnima Dalal.
Her listed education includes University of Mumbai and Narsee Monjee College of Commerce and Economics.

sections.heading: Nita Ambani — Career and Professional Work
paras: Nita Ambani works primarily as a philanthropist, with Reliance Foundation listed among her employers.
She has held the following offices: chairperson (2010–present) and member of the International Olympic Committee (2016–present).

She has taken part in World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2015, World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2016, World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2017, World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2018 and World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2019.

sections.heading: Nita Ambani — Family, Marriage and Personal Life
paras: She is married to Mukesh Ambani (married 1985).
She is a parent to Akash Ambani, Isha Ambani and Anant Ambani.
She is associated with Mumbai as a place of residence.
